tools.name: find_pros
tools.title: Find licensed pros
tools.description: Find pros for a home job on the marketplace and check each license in the Florida license registry. Pros whose license is not verified are left out.

job_summary.description: What needs doing, in the homeowner's words

tools.name: book_job
tools.title: Book a pro
tools.description: Book one of the pros from the last search. confirm=false gets an estimate and reads the booking back for voice confirmation; confirm=true books it after the homeowner said yes.

confirm.description: true only after the homeowner confirmed the read-back

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel a booking
tools.description: Cancel the current booking, also in a later conversation. confirm=false reads the booking and cancellation policy back; confirm=true cancels after the homeowner said yes.

job_id.description: Job id such as J1; defaults to the current job

tools.name: review_invoice
tools.title: Check the invoice
tools.description: Check the pro's invoice against the agreed scope with deterministic rules: license re-check, visit from front door camera arrive/leave events, and photos per item. Returns what can be paid now and what waits.

job_id.description: Job id such as J1; defaults to the current job

tools.name: prepare_checkout
tools.title: Prepare checkout for the proven items
tools.description: Prepare a checkout for only the proven items of the last invoice check. Takes no payment data; Alexa+ completes the payment with the customer's voice code and saved card.

job_id.description: Job id such as J1; defaults to the current job

tools.name: job_status
tools.title: What's left on a job
tools.description: Say what is still open on the current job (unproven items, charges outside the scope, unpaid amounts), from saved state. Works in any later conversation.

job_id.description: Job id such as J1; defaults to the current job

tools.name: draft_note
tools.title: Draft a note to the pro
tools.description: Draft a plain note to the pro about what is still open. The homeowner sends it; this add-on never sends messages.

job_id.description: Job id such as J1; defaults to the current job

tools.name: warranty_callback
tools.title: Warranty return visit
tools.description: Check whether a problem after a finished job is covered by the pro's labor warranty and, after the homeowner confirms, book a free return visit with the original scope, photos and visit log attached. confirm=false checks and offers; confirm=true books.

issue.description: What is wrong, in the homeowner's words; may be omitted with confirm=true to accept the offer just read back

confirm.description: true only after the homeowner accepted the offered return visit

job_id.description: Job id such as J1; defaults to the current job
